mathematics.assertion_tested: Compare existing Cholesky insertion/deletion kernels with fresh NumPy/SciPy factorizations, checking reconstruction before timing.
mathematics.conventions: Lower triangular factors of SPD Gram matrices; reconstruction relative Frobenius error below 1e-12. Full methods include Gram-submatrix gathering. Update methods include candidate cross-products gathering.
inputs: Seeded Gaussian design with 2(s+1) rows and s+1 columns; Gram plus identity
non_claims: No universal crossover threshold or near-singular stability guarantee.
One seeded well-conditioned matrix per size is a bounded numerical comparison.
